verdict.rationale: The vendor says there is no new interface: you text or call the agent, and you can even revoke access by starting a conversation with it. Hands-on reviewers confirm this, asking in iMessage and having Instinct place calls, book reservations, order pizza and handle email follow-ups, with confirmations coming back in the same chat. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the command scope, and consistent compliance with natural-language requests (one user's request to delete his Gmail data was refused until a settings tool was added; another hit credential snags with Obsidian/GitHub).
